module_summary: IP frame demultiplexer: on header accept latches select and drop, registers the header and broadcasts it with one-hot valid, then routes payload through a skid buffer to the chosen output until tlast.

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Latched output port index steering one-hot header and payload valid

anchors.name: drop_reg
anchors.why: Frame drop flag suppressing output valids while still consuming payload

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-in-progress flag; blocks new header accept until tlast

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: External output select captured at frame start

anchors.name: drop
anchors.why: External drop request captured at frame start

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Gates input header and payload ready outputs

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input header valid; with ready starts a frame

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Input header ready when idle and no pending output header

anchors.name: s_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Representative input header field latched at frame start

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: One-hot output header valid for selected port

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-output header ready clearing header valid bits

anchors.name: m_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Representative registered header field broadcast to all outputs

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload data passed to the internal datapath

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid, shifted to selected output valid

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready during frame when output ready or dropping

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame; clears frame and drop flags

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data replicated to all output ports

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-output payload valid from skid-buffer register

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-output ready controlling skid-buffer transfers

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output payload register loaded from int or temp path

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp register holding a beat when output stalls

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready deciding output vs temp storage

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output payload registers from internal path

groups.name: Frame route control
groups.description: Captures select/drop at header accept and tracks frame until tlast

groups.name: Header register
groups.description: Registers input header fields and raises one-hot valid on selected output

groups.name: Payload input
groups.description: Accepts input payload and forms per-output internal valid

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the replicated output payload streams
